summary: VitalikButerin 继续解读 strawmap 的抗量子部分：共识层 BLS 签名、KZG 数据可用性、EOA 的 ECDSA 签名与应用层 ZK 证明四处量子脆弱，需逐步处理。SirSpudlington 提交 EIP-7932 公钥与签名分离，并在 Magicians 指出后量子交易迁移方案过多。zksecurityXYZ 报告首批针对线上 ZK 电路的攻击，源于 Groth16 验证器未完成可信设置。

items.title: EIP-7932：支持公钥与签名分离
items.note: （SirSpudlington）提交：secp256k1 算法 ID 由 0xff 改为 0x0，限制算法类型不超过 126，新增 merge_detached_signature 并修复与 secp256k1 的公钥冲突；Magicians：后量子迁移、加密敏捷与如何防止 EIP-7932 失败（SirSpudlington）05:28，列举纯 ERC-4337、EIP-6404 SSZ 交易等多条做同一件事的路径。
items.title_en: EIP-7932: add support for public key and signature separation
items.note_en: (SirSpudlington), submitted: moves secp256k1 to 0x0 from 0xff, restricts algorithm types above 126, adds merge_detached_signature and fixes a public key collision with secp256k1; Magicians: Post Quantum migrations, crypto agility and how to prevent EIP-7932 from failing (SirSpudlington), 05:28, listing many routes doing the same thing, from pure ERC-4337 to EIP-6404 SSZ transactions.

keywords_en: VitalikButerin on the quantum resistance roadmap
four quantum vulnerable parts of Ethereum
EIP-7932 public key and signature separation
crypto agility and keeping EIP-7932 from failing
the first exploits of live ZK circuits
summary_en: VitalikButerin continued through the strawmap's quantum section: consensus BLS signatures, KZG data availability, EOA ECDSA signatures and application ZK proofs are the four quantum vulnerable parts, to be handled step by step. SirSpudlington submitted EIP-7932 public key and signature separation and argued on Magicians that there are too many post-quantum transaction migration proposals. zksecurityXYZ reported the first exploits against live ZK circuits, caused by Groth16 verifiers deployed without completing the trusted setup.
